plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-16 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'LVN to Registered Nursing map for 2026-2027' and the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The live browser also transcribed this program's 2025-2026 map and compared it row by row: every Bakersfield College course row is identical in the two catalog years; only term numbering/years and milestone placement differ. This plan files the 2026-2027 view. This plan transcribes the program's first/default pathway, 'LVN to Registered Nursing Associate of Science', in full; it is a Bakersfield College-only map with no second-institution section. The map displays 9 terms: Term 1 (Getting Started) and Term 9 (After Completion) are milestone-only and carry no course content, so the seven substantive terms (map Terms 2-8, including the Summer term carrying NURS B51) are encoded here as semesters 1-7 in map order. The program page lists a second pathway for the same AS credential, 'Bakersfield College LVN to Registered Nursing AS 62 units 7 terms to CSU', which is not collected as a separate plan. The transcribed map prints the degree total as a range, 60-61.5 units, and substantive term totals as 10-11.5 / 10 / 11 / 11 / 2 / 8.5 / 7.5. The only ranged row is the first term's '1.A. English Communication (BC)' slot (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention it is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. Course titles are recorded exactly as printed, including '2. Mathematics or Quantitative Reason (BC)' ('Reason' is singular as printed). No row on the map shows a 'Prerequisites', 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag in Card View, so no prereqs are recorded. General-education and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'This program map represents one possible pathway through the program and may not reflect the most current catalog requirements. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan that fits your needs.'
